QuestInfo.name: [The Afterlands] Go Out and Smell the Roses
QuestInfo.0: Now that you've moved #p9400217# out of the castle, only #p9400216# remains inside of the castle walls. Help him leave the castle.
QuestInfo.1: Now that you've moved #p9400217# out of the castle, only #p9400216# remains inside the castle walls. Help him move both himself and his treasure out of the castle.
QuestInfo.2: After first helping #p9400216# out of the castle, you moved his treasure.\r\nAs with the others, #p9400216# has quickly become enamored with the beauty of the outside world.
